verdict.rationale: PayPal offers instant sign-up onboarding via Payment Links and PayPal Checkout that require no coding skills and can go live same-day, plus explicit support for 400M PayPal users, debit/credit cards, and Pay Later, with sandbox testing to validate quickly. Community evidence raises concerns about fund holds and disputes but does not contradict the core claim of fast onboarding to accept a card payment. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the exact time-to-first-transaction and country-specific approval timelines.
